snippets.title: Create a payment payload in Python (client)
snippets.code:
from x402 import x402Client
from x402.mechanisms.evm.exact import ExactEvmScheme

client = x402Client()
client.register("eip155:*", ExactEvmScheme(signer=my_signer))

# Create payment from 402 response
payload = await client.create_payment_payload(payment_required)
snippets.note: From the Python README (async client). PyPI x402 2.x implements V2.

snippets.title: Register a scheme on a Python resource server
snippets.code:
from x402 import x402ResourceServer
from x402.http import HTTPFacilitatorClient
from x402.mechanisms.evm.exact import ExactEvmServerScheme

facilitator = HTTPFacilitatorClient(url="https://x402.org/facilitator")
server = x402ResourceServer(facilitator)
server.register("eip155:*", ExactEvmServerScheme())
server.initialize()
snippets.note: First lines of the Python README server example; the README continues with ResourceConfig and framework middleware.
